sourceTitle: Notes on the book of Exodus
description: "Notes on the Book of Exodus" by Charles Henry Mackintosh is a theological commentary written in the late 19th century. The work delves into the themes of redemption as depicted in the biblical Book of Exodus, discussing the significance of God's covenant and the redemptive power of the blood of Christ.
